topics.title: What is a mineral
topics.ncert_sections: What is a mineral?; Study of minerals by geographers and geologists

concepts.learning_objective: Define a mineral and explain how minerals make up rocks.
Explain why minerals vary in their properties and distinguish how geographers and geologists study them.
Describe how minerals occur as veins and lodes in igneous and metamorphic rocks.
Explain how minerals form in sedimentary beds, by evaporation and as residual deposits.
Describe placer deposits and the minerals obtained from ocean waters and ocean beds.

topics.title: Ferrous minerals: iron ore and manganese

concepts.learning_objective: Compare magnetite and hematite in terms of iron content and use.
Identify the major iron ore belts of India, their mines and export ports.
State the uses of manganese and its role in steel making.

topics.title: Non-ferrous, non-metallic and rock minerals
topics.ncert_sections: Non-ferrous minerals; Copper; Bauxite; Non-metallic minerals; Rock minerals

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the uses and distribution of copper and bauxite in India.
Explain the properties, uses and distribution of mica.
State the occurrence and uses of limestone.

topics.title: Hazards of mining and conservation of minerals
topics.ncert_sections: Hazards of mining; Conservation of minerals

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the impact of mining on the health of miners and on the environment.
Explain why mineral resources must be conserved and suggest ways of doing so.

topics.title: Conventional sources of energy
topics.ncert_sections: Energy resources; Conventional sources of energy

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish the types of coal and describe the distribution of coal in India.
Explain the occurrence, uses and distribution of petroleum and natural gas in India.
Distinguish between hydroelectricity and thermal electricity.

topics.title: Non-conventional sources and conservation of energy
topics.ncert_sections: Non-conventional sources of energy; Conservation of energy resources

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how nuclear and solar energy are obtained and where their resources are found in India.
Explain how wind, tidal, geothermal energy and biogas are harnessed and where in India.
Evaluate the need for and ways of conserving energy resources.
